decisions.reason: The operator line builds directly on the firm's core door and drive know-how and had its own page, so the firm can interpret feedback and keep refining it, though it was not observed on the website in 2020 to 2021.

Solid wood lies outside the firm's steel and materials core and was only mentioned online and then not observed, which weakens its ability to learn from results, but it still rounds out the one-source garage range.
The remote-control operator rests on knowledge the firm already holds, but its overlap with the Product A line makes folding it into that line likely.
The glazed industrial door extends core industrial door competence, but F has already been withdrawn and the overlap with E raises the risk of further range consolidation.
The insulated glazed door uses the firm's thermal expertise and meets demand driven by energy regulation, which gives it the strongest basis for further development among the industrial variants.
